name: n8n-nodes-ibanforge
description: IBAN validation, BIC/SWIFT lookup, Swiss clearing and compliance pre-checks for n8n workflows, backed by national bank registers (121k+ BIC entries, 89 IBAN countries)

scripts.build: tsc && mkdir -p dist/nodes/IbanForge dist/credentials && cp nodes/IbanForge/ibanforge.svg nodes/IbanForge/IbanForge.node.json dist/nodes/IbanForge/ && cp credentials/ibanforge.svg dist/credentials/
